title: The Ironbound oil cask used to burn the Hollow Throne (the ending action) is still listed in the final carried-items recap after being spent — 'cask of Ironbound oil (enough to burn a throne)' — unlike the earlier cinder-oil cask at Pennywell's vault door, which was correctly removed from inventory the moment it was used.
